system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

Konjiki’s ultimate form of Metallurgy, infusing liquid metal into your skin, granting you metal like resilience, but also the ability to manifest any tool needed to accomplish any task at hand.

As a Bonus action, you enter your Mercury Foundry state, coating yourself in liquid metal for the next minute. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a short rest.
